$comment: Hand-authored theme palettes. 'highlight' (optional, default the first structure colour) marks titles, the selected item and values a variant changes. for the Dex, from on-screen research (see the Design Language wiki page). pipeline/build_data.py checks every text colour against WCAG AA and writes app/assets/data/themes.json. Each theme names its sources; 'confidence' is canon (seen on screen and documented), fan (fan reconstructions of on-screen graphics) or proposed (our choice where nothing is documented). 'headingFont' (optional) names a bundled font family for frame lettering, buttons and titles; body text always stays in the platform font. 'scriptFont' (optional, factions) names the faction's own script, used only to decorate: the screen title is repeated in it, hidden from screen readers.
